reviewed_by: Automated static review, 2026-10-23 (Binary Ninja MCP, Radare2 6.2.0, angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast) against retail igi.exe and the current terrain_loaders.cpp
scope: Structural and return-path review of retail Terrain_Load (0x004C6240) and its host file-stage bridge. The candidate does not reproduce the retail context layout, QVM registration/execution or the context+0xDC8 tail write; behavioral equivalence is not claimed.

runtime_contract.note: The only runtime observation is one retail load-phase call in build/runtime-traces/20261023T015650-level1-retail (EAX 0x038910B4 = the context argument). There is no paired candidate capture; this contract does not authorize runtime acceptance.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and Radare2 both identify one function at 0x004C6240 with identical CFG node/edge sets (25 blocks, 36 edges; body 0x004C6240-0x004C666C, 1069 bytes). angr CFGFast recovers the exact entry with no unresolved jumps. The candidate entry is igi::retail::terrain::Terrain_Load at 0x00459730 in the fresh x86 candidate.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail is x86 cdecl with context at [esp+4] (moved to EBP at 0x004C62B6) and the path pointer at [esp+8]. The candidate takes void* context and const char* base_path in the same order and derives the terrain directory from base_path.parent_path().

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Retail's context offsets (+0x8, +0xC, +0xDC0, +0xDC4, +0xDCC, +0xDD0, +0xDC8) and 0x1000/0x10000 allocations are host-adapted into TerrainLevelData members. No literal constant equivalence is claimed.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The host object stores typed arrays and vectors instead of the retail context offsets; no byte-identical memory layout or access claim is made.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail calls Render_ComputeNormals_3, Resource_Load/Resource_FileExists for .bit/.hmp/.cmd/.ctr, Game_DefineOptions, Qvm_Load/Execute/Cleanup, Sys_CloseFileStream_23 and Mem_AllocFn. The host bridge runs Terrain_LoadLevel with apply_tasks=false and does not reproduce QVM registration/execution or the DynObj_UpdateDynTree_11 context+0xDC8 write. Those divergences are recorded; call/side-effect equivalence is not part of this structural claim.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail has a single ret at 0x004C666C. The only tail call is DynObj_UpdateDynTree_11(context) at 0x004C665A; that native (0x004CE3D0) is `mov eax,[esp+4]; mov [eax+0xDC8],0; ret`, so EAX is arg1 on every path. The live retail call returned 0x038910B4, exactly its context argument. The candidate returns the context pointer after the file stage on every path that corresponds to a retail path, and returns nullptr only on a host-only null guard that retail does not have. It does not perform the context+0xDC8 write because the port object does not mirror that offset.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Neither the retail function nor the candidate load path performs floating-point arithmetic.

review_findings: Retail control flow has one exit and the return value is DynObj_UpdateDynTree_11(context) = arg1; the live observation 0x038910B4 equals the context argument.
The candidate returns the context pointer on all retail-corresponding paths; the host-only null guard returns nullptr.
The candidate is a host file-stage bridge: 12 blocks / 383 bytes plus Terrain_LoadLevel, versus retail 25 blocks / 1069 bytes. Its CFG is not equivalent.
Retail context offsets, QVM registration/execution and the context+0xDC8 write are not reproduced.
No paired candidate runtime capture exists; status is capped at STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED.
limits: Host file-stage bridge only; retail .bit/.hmp pointer tables, context offsets, QVM registration/execution and Mem_Alloc calls are not byte-identical.
The context+0xDC8 clear performed inside DynObj_UpdateDynTree_11 is not performed; the arg1 return value is reproduced.
